objectives.title: Adequacy Decision Transfer Basis
objectives.description: The contract contains writings regarding data transfers based on European Commission adequacy findings.
criteria: Identification of recipient destinations recognized by adequacy decisions.
Statements confirming transfers require no specific supervisory authorization.
Documentation establishing the geographic scope of recipient jurisdictions.

objectives.title: Adequacy Decision Invalidation Response
objectives.description: The contract contains writings regarding changes to the adequacy status of destination territories.
criteria: Procedures triggered by the formal repeal of an adequacy decision.
Protocols activated upon European Commission suspension of destination adequacy.
Notification obligations following alterations in adequacy status.
